Everything your treatment plan includes:
(Weekly injection or daily pill if clinically appropriate)
Prescription medication that reduces hunger and "food noise", helping you naturally eat less and maintain a calorie deficit without constant hunger or reliance on willpower. Numan currently offers
. Your clinician will assess which is right for you.

Our registered clinicians review your assessment and prescribe medication if appropriate. From there, they are available whenever you need them, whether that's to discuss how your treatment is working, request a dose adjustment, or raise a medical concern.

Your health coach is your day-to-day point of contact throughout your entire programme. They support the everyday side of your journey, helping you build healthier habits, improve your relationship with food, stay active, and make lasting lifestyle changes alongside your treatment.
Log your data, track your weight loss progress, access personalised tips, and stay connected with your health coach throughout your programme.
Not every treatment looks the same. Your clinician will recommend the right option based on your BMI, health history, and preferences, including whether you'd prefer a pill to an injection.

heading, Help if side effects arise, level 2
The most common side effects are gastrointestinal, including nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, and constipation. Side effects are reported by approximately 12–18% of patients
and are usually temporary. If they persist, your clinician can adjust your treatment. For a complete list, see the Summary of Product Characteristics at
heading, Guidance on long-term effects, level 2

We know long-term use raises questions. Obesity is a chronic condition, and for many people, ongoing treatment provides the best long-term outcomes. Your clinical team will work with you to make the right decisions for your health, both now and in the future.

Your health coach is your first point of contact for weight maintenance guidance. Whether you continue treatment, adjust your approach, or need to re-enter the programme at any point, they'll support you with advice and a plan that works for your life. Any clinical questions around dosing are referred to our medical team.
